trigger.description: ee context --since receives a pack hash that was not emitted for the current workspace, has been evicted by pack-record retention, or belongs to a different workspace, so ee returns the full pack instead of computing an unverifiable delta.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Delta prior unknown fixture memory.' --workspace . --level procedural --kind fact --json
trigger.invocation: ee context 'delta prior unknown fixture' --workspace . --since deadbeef --json

expected_emission.repair_string: Run ee context without --since, or pass a pack hash from a prior ee context --json response in the same workspace while the pack record is still retained.
